items.claim: The first opened directory is the intended directory
items.reason: CreateFileW follows the path present at open time

items.claim: The handle's volume serial and file index identify the opened object
items.reason: GetFileInformationByHandle is queried. It does not recover a pre-open identity.

items.claim: The child is a non-reparse directory on the parent handle's volume
items.reason: Observed for a normal create. Cross-volume kernel case not executed.

items.claim: The child is created with RootDirectory and FILE_CREATE
items.reason: The assumption is that the parent handle is already the intended object.

items.claim: An opened object with FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT is rejected
items.reason: A real junction was rejected. Other tags were not enumerated.

items.claim: A junction path is not used as a parent
items.reason: mklink /J before open failed closed on this machine.

items.claim: A directory symlink is rejected by the kernel path
items.reason: os.symlink failed with errno 22 and was not counted as a pass.

items.claim: The initial pathname race is closed
Later creates stay on the opened object

items.reason: G.14.7 regression still completes only through verify_member_bytes.

items.claim: The synthetic lock is written through the child handle
items.reason: True relative to the opened child. The child follows the unverified parent.

items.claim: Closed handles and deleted directories do not create a replacement file
Another process as the same user cannot redirect the open
items.reason: The swap required no extra privilege.

critical_findings: INITIAL_PATH_RACE_UNVERIFIED: a same-user path replacement before CreateFileW selects the directory that later receives the child, artifacts, and synthetic lock
high_findings: Real directory symlink behavior was not executed
medium_findings: NTSTATUS values other than 0 and 0xC0000035 are collapsed
